metadata.description: Controlled Repository-Context Ablation Pilot Fixtures (6 Multi-File Micro-Repositories)

fixtures.expected_clean_rationale: File writes use path containment verification after sanitize_filename strips directory traversal markers, null bytes, and path separators.
fixtures.cross_file_relationship: storage.py delegates filename safety to validators.sanitize_filename; inspecting storage.py in isolation may prompt an unanchored LLM to warn of unconstrained user filename traversal.

fixtures.expected_clean_rationale: Document retrieval enforces strict tenant boundary check via assert_tenant_boundary before returning sensitive payload.
fixtures.cross_file_relationship: documents.py queries by primary document ID without tenant filter in the query itself, but immediately invokes authz.assert_tenant_boundary; without context, an LLM may flag IDOR or missing tenant isolation.

fixtures.expected_clean_rationale: Dynamic table identifier interpolation is safe because validate_table_whitelist validates against an immutable frozenset, and query values use parameter markers.
fixtures.cross_file_relationship: reports.py uses f-string formatting for table identifier; in isolation, this looks like classic SQL injection, but schema_whitelist.py proves table identifier is strictly whitelisted.

fixtures.expected_clean_rationale: Login verification uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time comparison, preceded by sliding-window rate limit enforcement on username.
fixtures.cross_file_relationship: login_handler.py relies on SlidingWindowRateLimiter to guard credential verification; in isolation, reviewer cannot verify rate limiting implementation details.

fixtures.expected_clean_rationale: Stream reading loop is bounded by BoundedStreamReader which enforces hard caps on cumulative bytes read and chunk count, preventing memory exhaustion.
fixtures.cross_file_relationship: chunk_consumer.py runs a while-True chunk reading loop; in isolation, this can be mistaken for unbounded memory consumption or denial of service.

fixtures.security_pattern: CSPRNG Key Management & HMAC Token Signing
fixtures.expected_clean_rationale: Session tokens are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using 256-bit CSPRNG keys with automatic rotation and constant-time verification.
fixtures.cross_file_relationship: token_signer.py calls vault.get_signing_key(); in isolation, a reviewer might hallucinate that keys are static, predictable, or unrotated.
